blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Davao City assessor testifying for Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team in her impeachment trial was warned on Tuesday that he could be cited for contempt after evading questions about whether he had traveled to China in 2025. Engineer Jaime Adalin was presented by the defense in connection with allegations that Duterte had unexplained wealth and failed to truthfully declare all her assets in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN).
